services.name: Past Exhibits
services.desc: Charlotte Street Arts Centre has seen a lot of amazing artists present in the Charlotte Glencross and Penny Galleries over the years. June 18 - July 20, 2026: Stay by Eva Christensen and solo exhibition by Yuliana Gradovich. Eva’s exhibition featured more than 50 paintings, primarily in gouache, exploring her past six years as a dog owner. Yuliana’s debut exhibition featured a range of impressive watercolour paintings by this 12 year old artist. March 5 - April 27: Where Water Wanders by Alyssa Martin featured several large scale oil paintings documenting places in the Fundy region of New Brunswick that are often far from most peoples’ experiences. services.name: Pilates & Movement for Seniors
services.desc: This gentle, yet challenging, low impact and fun class will offer exercises seated in a chair and standing. It is intended for adults starting out or returning to a movement class after a break and those who may have some mobility issues. Individuals who have difficulties with getting down and up from the floor are most welcome to join. Based on the Pilates principles of breath, control, concentration and precision, participants will be guided to practice mindful movements that will promote spinal alignment, joint mobility, good posture, improved balance and strength. services.name: Midweek Yoga
services.desc: Join yoga instructor Anuja Chaini for this Wednesday evening yoga class at the Charlotte Street Arts Centre. Anuja brings a wealth of experience matched by 250 hours of training in Hatha Yoga. This class is designed for students of all ages from first time yogis to intermediate learners with a focus on yoga postures, pranayama/breathing exercise and relaxation techniques, all in a relaxed and supportive atmosphere. services.name: Camps & Programs
services.desc: Jam Sesh is an activity aimed at girls, transgendered youth, and gender creative youth to further their skills and understanding of playing in a band. We provide participants with drums, basses, guitars, and keyboards. Jam Sesh meets once a month and happens through the year! The Shivering Songs Songwriter’s Intensive offers a professional development opportunity for emerging musicians in New Brunswick. In collaboration with the Shivering Songs Festival, we invite a nationally acclaimed songwriter to engage in collaborative work with a group of a dozen emerging singer/songwriters from New Brunswick.
